title: Guide
intro: Everything you need to get started: follow the steps in order. The guide stays available during a session too.

prerequisites.title: Before you start
steps: Open Settings, paste your key into Anthropic API key and press Save. Without a key, Run analysis cannot produce the debrief.
Azure voice, voice commands and dictation need an Azure key and region (Azure Speech section); for the Azure voice also switch Status on. Otherwise alerts and answers use the system voice.
Assign a controller button or a keyboard key in the Voice assistant section (button Assign): you use it to talk to the coach.
This guide is always available: switching tab does not close your session.

session.title: Starting a session
steps: Start your simulator and get on track, then press New session, pick the game (RaceRoom, Assetto Corsa EVO or Automobilista 2) and confirm with Open session. The chosen game must already be sending data.
Each pass over the line adds a lap to the table. Show telemetry plots brake, throttle and speed for that lap; invalid laps can be hidden with the filter above the table.
The session stays open until you press End session: recorded laps stay in the list.
To go back to a closed session open Session list and use Reopen session.

driving.title: Driving with the coach
steps: On track the coach only speaks when something is wrong: at most one alert per zone per lap, with at least 4 seconds of silence between alerts.
It learns your thresholds over the first 2 laps: technique alerts get more precise from the third lap.
Safety alerts (for example critical brake temperature) interrupt everything; traction control and ABS anomalies are queued; technique tips come after the corner.
To silence all voice use the toggle in the title bar, or Voice output in Settings.

setup.title: Loading the setup
steps: Open Manage setups: the setup you load is linked to the following laps, and you can reuse setups already loaded for the same car and track.

RaceRoom: copy the setup in the game with CTRL+C and press Load from JSON. Assetto Corsa EVO: Select file and pick the .carsetup file. Automobilista 2: take screenshots of the setup screen and press Capture screenshots.

By voice: say acquire setup and the coach asks for a name (RaceRoom from the clipboard, Automobilista 2 from the last 3 screenshots). With Assetto Corsa EVO it uses the latest file and its file name, without asking.
To link a setup to several laps already recorded, select them in the table and press Assign setup (N).

voice.title: Talking to the coach
steps: The key is assigned in Settings, Voice assistant section: Controller or Keyboard. Assigning one removes the other.
Press it once, do not hold it: you hear the activation sound and have 5 seconds to speak. Recording stops by itself.
While the coach is processing or answering, further presses are ignored until the answer ends.
You can ask free questions (short radio-style answers) or give commands: new session RaceRoom, close session, analyze session, acquire setup. Saying the assistant's name gets a greeting.

analysis.title: Session analysis
steps: After a few laps press Run analysis: it calls the Claude API and produces a summary with suggested actions, which the coach reads aloud.
For more detail press Show deep-dive analysis in the analysis: it is a second, longer call that adds telemetry, problems and a setup comparison.
Each analysis is its own version: with Comment you add a note, typed or dictated, and the coach folds it in.
Setup advice comes one change at a time: apply it, drive a few laps and run the analysis again.

history.title: History, PDF and cleanup
steps: Session list gathers the sessions of all three games, with filters for game, car and track and sorting by date. Click a row to open its detail.
Inside a session, Export PDF saves the report with summary and deep-dive analysis.
You can delete single, selected or all sessions: laps, setups and analyses go with them, and it cannot be undone.
